key_idea: The letters that can be kept form a strictly increasing subsequence, so the answer is 26 minus the length of the longest strictly increasing subsequence.
sketch: Any strictly increasing subsequence of s can be completed to a..z by inserting the missing letters, and conversely the kept letters must be increasing, so answer = 26 - LIS. O(n^2) DP with n<=50. Pitfall: strict increase (repeated letters cannot both be used).
